title: Pure Performapal
summary: Yuya Sakaki's Performapal archetype is a colorful Pendulum swarm, draw, and ATK-boosting engine led by Performapal Skullcrobat Joker, Performapal Pendulum Sorcerer, Performapal Monkeyboard, Performapal Guitartle, and Performapal Lizardraw! Activate Scale 6 Guitartle and Scale 1 Monkeyboard (which searches Skullcrobat Joker or Lizardraw!) to draw 1 card from Guitartle, then destroy Lizardraw in your other Pendulum Zone to draw a 2nd card! When you Pendulum Summon Performapal Pendulum Sorcerer, it destroys up to 2 cards you control to search up to 2 Performapal monsters with different names from your Deck—flooding the field for Beyond the Pendulum, Performapal Gatlinghoul, and Odd-Eyes Vortex Dragon!

allow.Duelist Alliance: Searches Performapal Pendulum Sorcerer (because it has 'Pendulum' in its name!) directly from your Deck while any card is in a Pendulum Zone.
allow.Sky Iris: Yuya's Field Spell that destroys a Performapal card you control to search any 'Odd-Eyes' card (including Performapal Odd-Eyes Seer, Dissolver, Synchron, or Butler!).
allow.Terraforming: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Sky Iris.
allow.Beyond the Pendulum: Link-2 Pendulum monster that searches Performapal Monkeyboard, Guitartle, or Pendulum Sorcerer before you Pendulum Summon.
allow.Exceed the Pendulum: Link-3 Pendulum monster that adds a face-up Performapal from your Extra Deck to your hand and Special Summons a Performapal from your hand or GY.
allow.Majester Paladin, the Ascending Dracosla: Rank 4 Xyz made with Level 4 Performapals that searches any Performapal Pendulum during the End Phase.
allow.Nirvana High Paladin: Signature Level 10 Synchro Pendulum boss (summoned using Performapal Odd-Eyes Synchron + Level 8 Dissolver) that recovers any card from your GY on Synchro Summon and halves your opponent's LP when destroying a monster by battle!

main: Performapal Skullcrobat Joker
Core Level 4 DARK Spellcaster Pendulum (Scale 8): when Normal Summoned, adds ANY 'Performapal', 'Magician', or 'Odd-Eyes' monster from your Deck to your hand!
Performapal Pendulum Sorcerer

Core Level 4 EARTH Spellcaster Pendulum (Scale 2; searchable by Duelist Alliance!): when Special Summoned, destroys up to 2 cards you control to add an equal number of 'Performapal' monsters with different names from your Deck to your hand!
Performapal Monkeyboard
Core Level 6 EARTH Beast Pendulum (Scale 1; Unlimited in TCG!): during your Main Phase, adds ANY Level 4 or lower 'Performapal' monster from your Deck to your hand!
Performapal Guitartle
Core Level 1 WATER Aqua Pendulum (Scale 6): once per turn, when a 'Performapal' card is activated in your OTHER Pendulum Zone, you immediately draw 1 card!
Performapal Lizardraw
Core Level 3 EARTH Reptile Pendulum (Scale 6): if you have a 'Performapal' card in your other Pendulum Zone, destroys itself in the Pendulum Zone to draw 1 card!
Performapal Celestial Magician
Level 4 DARK Spellcaster Pendulum (Scale 8): during your Main Phase, activates bonus effects for each Extra Deck monster type you control.
Performapal Odd-Eyes Dissolver
Level 8 DARK Spellcaster Pendulum (Scale 4): Fusion Summons once per turn in the Pendulum Zone OR on the field using monsters from your hand, field, or Pendulum Zones without Polymerization!
Performapal Odd-Eyes Synchron

Level 2 DARK Spellcaster Pendulum Tuner (Scale 6): when Normal Summoned, revives a Level 3 or lower Performapal/Odd-Eyes from your GY; and Special Summons 1 card from your Pendulum Zone as a Level 1 Tuner to Synchro Summon!
Performapal Odd-Eyes Seer

Level 6 DARK Spellcaster Pendulum (Scale 1): in the Pendulum Zone, targets 1 Performapal/Odd-Eyes in your GY to add it to your hand; on the field, activates a Performapal from your GY into your Pendulum Zone!
Performapal Dag Daggerman
Level 4 EARTH Beast that discards 1 card to add a Performapal from your GY to your hand, and adds 1 Performapal from Deck to hand when summoned while you have 2 scales!
Performapal Silver Claw
Level 4 DARK Beast Pendulum (Scale 5) that boosts all Performapal monsters you control by 300 ATK in the Pendulum Zone and another 300 ATK when declaring an attack.
Performapal Recasting
Reveals any number of 'Performapal' monsters from your hand, shuffles them into the Deck, and draws that many cards + 1!
Duelist Alliance
Searches Performapal Pendulum Sorcerer directly from your Deck.
Sky Iris
Protects your Performapal Pendulum Scales from being targeted by opponent's card effects, and destroys 1 face-up card you control to search Performapal Odd-Eyes Dissolver, Synchron, or Seer!
Terraforming
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Sky Iris.
extra: Signature Level 8 DARK Fiend Fusion boss: inflicts 200 burn damage for each card on the field on Fusion Summon, and destroys 1 monster your opponent controls and burns them for its original ATK!
Level 7 WIND Dragon Fusion boss: bounces an opponent's Attack Position monster on Summon and shuffles a face-up Pendulum from your Extra Deck into the Deck for an omni-negate!

Signature Level 10 Synchro Pendulum boss (summoned using Performapal Odd-Eyes Synchron + Level 8 Dissolver) that recovers any card from your GY on Synchro Summon and halves your opponent's LP when destroying a monster by battle!
Rank 4 Xyz made with Level 4 Performapals that searches any Performapal Pendulum during the End Phase.
Link-2 Pendulum monster that searches Monkeyboard, Guitartle, or Dissolver before you Pendulum Summon.
Link-3 Pendulum monster that recovers a Performapal from your Extra Deck and revives a Performapal during the Main Phase.
